comment: The toolchains of the kit itself that mise does not install. The bootstrap installs mise (its archive of each platform by sha256) after the npm of packageManager; mise installs the tools of mise.toml at the digests of mise.lock. install-tools then installs the build backend of the Python wheels (pythonBackend, by the sha256 of its wheel) and the Composer project of config/phpunit (phpunit), and, with rustup, the Rust nightly of exceptions, which the rust symbol extractor of parity-real runs.

exceptions.reason: the rust symbol extractor of parity, kit's own tool, reads rustdoc JSON, which only a nightly writes (rust-lang/rust#76578)
